overall_notes: The paper introduces clembench, a framework for evaluating chat-optimized language models through interactive dialogue games. It uses automatic metrics to evaluate game performance but does not employ LLM-as-judge or human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and simplification of metric variants.
